front: Qu'est-ce qui compte le plus pour toi dans la vie ?
pronunciation: [kes-kee kohnt luh plüs poor TWAH dahn lah VEE]
back: What matters most to you in life?
context: 'Ce qui compte' = what matters. A deep conversation starter.

front: Pour moi, la famille passe avant tout.
pronunciation: [poor MWAH, lah fah-MEE pas ah-vahn TOO]
back: For me, family comes before everything.
context: 'Passer avant' = to come first.

front: Je me suis fixé des objectifs ambitieux.
pronunciation: [zhuh muh swee feek-SAY day zob-zhek-teef zahn-bee-SYUH]
back: I've set myself ambitious goals.
context: 'Se fixer un objectif' = to set oneself a goal.

front: Il rêve de créer sa propre entreprise.
pronunciation: [eel rev duh kray-ay sah proh-prahn-truh-PREEZ]
back: He dreams of starting his own company.
context: 'Propre' before the noun = own; after = clean.

front: Elle a réussi à force de travail.
pronunciation: [el ah ray-ü-SEE ah fors duh trah-VAHY]
back: She succeeded through hard work.
context: 'À force de' = by dint of.

front: La réussite ne se mesure pas seulement à l'argent.
pronunciation: [lah ray-ü-SEET nuh suh muh-zür pah suhl-mahn ah lar-ZHAHN]
back: Success isn't measured only by money.
context: 'Se mesurer à' = to be measured by.

front: Il faut savoir tirer des leçons de ses échecs.
pronunciation: [eel foh sah-vwahr tee-ray day luh-SOHN duh say zay-SHEK]
back: You need to know how to learn from your failures.
context: 'Tirer des leçons de' = to learn lessons from. 'Un échec' = a failure.

front: J'ai décidé de changer de vie.
pronunciation: [zhay day-see-day duh shahn-zhay duh VEE]
back: I decided to change my life.
context: 'Changer de vie' = to make a big life change.

front: Elle a tout plaqué pour partir vivre à la campagne.
pronunciation: [el ah too plah-KAY poor par-teer vee-vruh ah lah kahm-PAN-yuh]
back: She dropped everything to go and live in the countryside.
context: 'Tout plaquer' = to quit everything (informal).

front: Beaucoup de cadres se reconvertissent dans l'artisanat.
pronunciation: [boh-koo duh KAH-druh suh ruh-kohn-vehr-TEES dahn lar-tee-zah-NAH]
back: Many executives are retraining as craftspeople.
context: 'Se reconvertir' = to retrain, change career. 'Un cadre' = a manager, executive.

front: Je cherche un meilleur équilibre entre vie pro et vie perso.
pronunciation: [zhuh shersh an meh-yuhr ay-kee-LEE-bruh ahn-truh vee PROH ay vee pehr-SOH]
back: I'm looking for a better work-life balance.
context: 'Vie pro / vie perso' = professional / personal life (informal abbreviations).

front: L'argent ne fait pas le bonheur.
pronunciation: [lar-zhahn nuh feh pah luh boh-NUHR]
back: Money doesn't buy happiness.
context: Proverb. Often completed jokingly: '…mais il y contribue' (but it helps).

front: Je préfère la qualité de vie à un gros salaire.
pronunciation: [zhuh pray-fehr lah kah-lee-tay duh VEE ah an groh sah-LEHR]
back: I prefer quality of life to a big salary.
context: 'Préférer A à B'.

front: La liberté est une valeur essentielle pour moi.
pronunciation: [lah lee-behr-tay eh tün vah-luhr eh-sahn-SYEL poor MWAH]
back: Freedom is an essential value for me.
context: 'Une valeur' = a value.

front: Liberté, Égalité, Fraternité : c'est la devise de la République.
pronunciation: [lee-behr-TAY, ay-gah-lee-TAY, frah-tehr-nee-TAY : seh lah duh-veez duh lah ray-pü-BLEEK]
back: Liberty, Equality, Fraternity: that's the motto of the Republic.
context: 'La devise' = motto. It's written on every town hall.

front: Il est très attaché à la justice sociale.
pronunciation: [ee leh treh zah-tah-shay ah lah zhüs-tees soh-SYAL]
back: He cares deeply about social justice.
context: 'Être attaché à' = to value, be committed to.

front: Elle s'engage bénévolement dans une association.
pronunciation: [el sahn-gahzh bay-nay-vol-mahn dahn zün nah-soh-syah-SYOHN]
back: She volunteers with a charity.
context: 'Bénévole' = volunteer. 'Une association' = non-profit organization.

front: Je veux donner un sens à mon travail.
pronunciation: [zhuh vuh doh-nay an SAHNS ah mohn trah-VAHY]
back: I want my work to be meaningful.
context: 'Donner du sens à' = to give meaning to. A big theme for younger French workers.

front: Il manque de confiance en lui.
pronunciation: [eel mahnk duh kohn-fyahns ahn LWEE]
back: He lacks self-confidence.
context: 'La confiance en soi' = self-confidence.

front: Il faut oser sortir de sa zone de confort.
pronunciation: [eel foh oh-zay sor-teer duh sah zohn duh kohn-FOR]
back: You have to dare to leave your comfort zone.
context: 'Oser' = to dare.

front: Je n'ai aucun regret.
pronunciation: [zhuh neh oh-kan ruh-GREH]
back: I have no regrets.
context: 'Ne… aucun' = no, not a single.

front: Avec le recul, j'aurais fait autrement.
pronunciation: [ah-vek luh ruh-KÜL, zhoh-reh feh oh-truh-MAHN]
back: With hindsight, I'd have done it differently.
context: 'Avec le recul' = with hindsight. Past conditional.

front: Il a toujours été très ambitieux.
pronunciation: [ee lah too-zhoor ay-tay treh zahn-bee-SYUH]
back: He's always been very ambitious.
context: In France, open ambition is sometimes viewed with suspicion.

front: Elle ne vit que pour son travail.
pronunciation: [el nuh vee kuh poor sohn trah-VAHY]
back: She lives only for her work.
context: 'Ne… que' = only.

front: Le temps, c'est de l'argent.
pronunciation: [luh TAHN, seh duh lar-ZHAHN]
back: Time is money.
context: Same proverb as in English.

front: Il ne faut pas remettre à demain ce qu'on peut faire le jour même.
pronunciation: [eel nuh foh pah ruh-meh-truh ah duh-MAN suh kohn puh fehr luh zhoor MEM]
back: Don't put off until tomorrow what you can do today.
context: 'Remettre à plus tard' = to postpone.

front: Rien n'est impossible à qui veut vraiment.
pronunciation: [ryan neh tan-poh-SEE-bluh ah kee vuh vreh-MAHN]
back: Nothing is impossible for someone who really wants it.
context: Compare 'Vouloir, c'est pouvoir' (where there's a will, there's a way).

front: Vouloir, c'est pouvoir.
pronunciation: [voo-LWAHR, seh poo-VWAHR]
back: Where there's a will, there's a way.
context: Literally 'to want is to be able'.

front: Je me sens enfin à ma place.
pronunciation: [zhuh muh sahn ahn-FAN ah mah PLAS]
back: I finally feel I'm where I belong.
context: 'Être à sa place' = to be in the right place, fit in.

front: Il traverse une crise de la quarantaine.
pronunciation: [eel trah-vehrs ün kreez duh lah kah-rahn-TEN]
back: He's going through a midlife crisis.
context: 'La quarantaine' = one's forties (also quarantine).

front: Elle a le sens des responsabilités.
pronunciation: [el ah luh sahns day res-pohn-sah-bee-lee-TAY]
back: She has a sense of responsibility.
context: 'Avoir le sens de' = to have a sense of.

front: L'honnêteté est la qualité que j'apprécie le plus.
pronunciation: [loh-net-TAY eh lah kah-lee-TAY kuh zhah-pray-see luh PLÜS]
back: Honesty is the quality I value most.
context: 'Apprécier' = to value, appreciate.

front: Je déteste l'hypocrisie.
pronunciation: [zhuh day-test lee-poh-kree-ZEE]
back: I hate hypocrisy.
context: 'Hypocrite' is the same word in both languages.

front: Le bonheur, c'est dans les petites choses.
pronunciation: [luh boh-NUHR, seh dahn lay puh-teet SHOHZ]
back: Happiness is in the little things.
context: A popular philosophy of life.

front: Il faut profiter de chaque instant.
pronunciation: [eel foh proh-fee-tay duh shak an-STAHN]
back: You have to make the most of every moment.
context: 'Profiter de' = to enjoy, make the most of.

front: Elle a une soif d'apprendre impressionnante.
pronunciation: [el ah ün swahf dah-prahn-druh an-preh-syoh-NAHNT]
back: She has an impressive thirst for learning.
context: 'Une soif de' = a thirst for.

front: Mes parents m'ont transmis le goût de l'effort.
pronunciation: [may pah-rahn mohn trahns-mee luh goo duh leh-FOR]
back: My parents passed on to me the value of hard work.
context: 'Transmettre' = to pass on.

front: Je ne me compare plus aux autres.
pronunciation: [zhuh nuh muh kohm-par plü oh ZOH-truh]
back: I don't compare myself to others anymore.
context: 'Ne… plus' = no longer.

front: Le plus important, c'est d'être fidèle à soi-même.
pronunciation: [luh plü zan-por-TAHN, seh deh-truh fee-del ah swah-MEM]
back: The most important thing is to stay true to yourself.
context: 'Fidèle à soi-même' = true to oneself.

front: Il a réalisé le rêve de sa vie.
pronunciation: [ee lah ray-ah-lee-ZAY luh rev duh sah VEE]
back: He fulfilled his lifelong dream.
context: 'Réaliser un rêve' = to make a dream come true.

front: Elle a fait preuve d'un courage exemplaire.
pronunciation: [el ah feh pruhv dan koo-rahzh eg-zahm-PLEHR]
back: She showed exemplary courage.
context: 'Faire preuve de' = to show, demonstrate.

front: Je suis prête à faire des sacrifices pour réussir.
pronunciation: [zhuh swee pret ah fehr day sah-kree-FEES poor ray-ü-SEER]
back: I'm ready to make sacrifices to succeed.
context: 'Être prêt(e) à' + infinitive.

front: On n'a qu'une vie.
pronunciation: [ohn nah kün VEE]
back: You only live once.
context: 'Ne… que' = only.

front: Chacun voit midi à sa porte.
pronunciation: [shah-kan vwah mee-DEE ah sah PORT]
back: Everyone sees things from their own point of view.
context: Proverb: literally 'everyone sees noon at their own door'.

front: La vie est un long fleuve tranquille… ou pas !
pronunciation: [lah vee eh tan lohn fluhv trahn-KEEL… oo PAH]
back: Life is a long, quiet river… or not!
context: From the title of a famous 1988 French comedy, used ironically.
